finding.title: Although `syslog` is not directly executing an OS command, the log message could potentially contain user input or other dynamic content that might be misinterpreted by the logging system or other downstream processes.

If the log message is constructed using user input or other dynamic content, it could lead to format string vulnerabilities. However, `syslog` typically does not use format strings in the way that `printf` does, so this risk is mitigated.
Similar to CWE-117, if the log message includes user input or other dynamic content, it could be misinterpreted by the logging system or other downstream processes.

scan_patch.message: Statically-sized arrays can be improperly restricted, leading to potential overflows or other issues (CWE-119!/CWE-120).
Easily used incorrectly; doesn't always \0-terminate or check for invalid pointers [MS-banned] (CWE-120).
